chunks: Muhammad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Isma'il ibn Jabir and Abd al-Karim ibn Amr and Abd al-Hamid ibn Abi al-Daylam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Noah (peace be upon him) lived for five hundred years after the flood. Then Gabriel (peace be upon him) came to him and said: 'O Noah! Your prophethood has expired and your days are complete, so look to the Greatest Name, and the inheritance of knowledge, and the traces of the knowledge of prophethood that are with you, and hand them over to your son Shem. For I do not leave the earth except that there is in it a knowledgeable one by whom obedience to Me is recognized, and My guidance is understood, and he is a salvation for what is between the passing away of a prophet and the sending of another prophet. And I would not leave the people without a proof from Me, a caller to Me, a guide to My path, and one who knows My affair. For I have decreed that I make for every people a guide by whom I guide the fortunate, and he becomes a proof from Me against the wretched.'

He said: So Noah (peace be upon him) handed over the Greatest Name, and the inheritance of knowledge, and the traces of the knowledge of prophethood to Shem. As for Ham and Japheth, there was no knowledge with them that they could benefit from. He said: And Noah (peace be upon him) gave them the good news of Hud (peace be upon him) and commanded them to follow him, and commanded them to open the will every year, and look into it, and make it a festival for themselves.

key_terms.آثار علم النبوة: Traces/effects of the knowledge of prophethood

ai.seo_question: What did Noah (peace be upon him) hand over to his son Shem after the flood?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the Shia doctrine of the continuity of divine proof (Hujjah) by depicting Noah transferring the 'Greatest Name' and prophetic inheritance to his son Shem, while Ham and Japheth were excluded. It underscores the theological necessity of an infallible guide between prophets to ensure humanity remains without excuse, a concept central to the Imamate. The narration also introduces the practice of annual testament review as a communal celebration of guidance, linking Noah’s legacy directly to the coming of Hud.

en.hubeali: H 14878 – Muhammad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Al-Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ismail Bin Jabir, and Abdul Kareem Bin Amro, and Abdul Hameed Bin Abu Al-Daylam, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws having said:

‘Noah<sup>as</sup> lived for five hundred years after the storm. Then Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> came to him<sup>as</sup>, so he<sup>as</sup> said: “O Noah<sup>as</sup>! Your<sup>as</sup> Prophet-hood has expired, and your<sup>as</sup> days are complete, so look to the Great Name (Al-Ism Al-Akbar), and inheritance of the Knowledge, and effects of the Knowledge of the Prophet-hood which is with you <sup>as</sup> and hand these over to your<sup>as</sup> son Saam<sup>as</sup>, for I<sup>azwj</sup> do not Leave the earth except that there is in it a Knowledgeable one by whom obedience to Me<sup>azwj</sup> can be recognised, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Guidance can be understood, and salvation can be in what is in between the passing away of a Prophet<sup>as</sup> and Sending of another Prophet<sup>as</sup> and I<sup>azwj</sup> never Leave the people without a Proof from Me<sup>azwj</sup> calling towards Me<sup>azwj</sup>, and guides to My<sup>azwj</sup> Way, and understand My<sup>azwj</sup> Commands, for I<sup>azwj</sup> have Ordained that I<sup>azwj</sup> shall Make for every people a guide who will guide the fortunate ones and will be the Argument from Me<sup>azwj</sup> against the wretched ones”.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So Noah<sup>as</sup> handed over the Great Name, and inheritance of the Knowledge, and effects of the Knowledge of the Prophet-hood to Saam<sup>as</sup>. And as for Haam, and Yaafas, so there was no knowledge in their possession that could be benefited from’. And Noah<sup>as</sup> gave them the good news of Hud<sup>as</sup> and commanded them to be obedient to him<sup>as</sup>, and commanded them that they will open the will during every year, and look into it, and make it to be a day of festivities for themselves’.
en.sarwar: 431. Ali Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al-Abbas, from Al-Hassan Bin Abdul Rahmaan, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Abu Hamza, who has narrated the following:

I asked Abu Ja’far (a.s.) that, ‘Some of our companions are fabricating (Hadeeth) and throwing them against the ones who oppose them’. So he (a.s.) said to me: ‘Refraining from them is more beautiful’. Then said: ‘By Allah (azwj), O Abu Hamza! The people, all of them, are the children of the transgressors (adultery) except for our (a.s.) Shites’. I said, ‘How can there be a way out for me, from this?’ So he (a.s.) said to me: ‘The Revealed Book of Allah (azwj) has Evidences against them. Surely, Allah (azwj) Made for us (a.s.) the People (a.s.) of the Household three portions in the whole of the spoils of war (Al-Fey). Then Allah (azwj) Said: “[8:41] And know that whatever you take as spoils of war, lo! a fifth thereof is for Allah, and for the messenger and for the kinsman (who hath need) and orphans and the needy and the wayfarer”. So we (a.s.) are the owners of Al-Khums (the fifth), and the spoils of war (Al-Fey), and it has been Made unlawful to all the people except for our (a.s.) Shites. By Allah (azwj), O Abu Hamza! There is no land which has been conquered, and no fifth (Khums) has been applied on anything from it except that it was unlawful for the one who received it for his genitals or assets. And if the truth were to appear (Al-Qaim (a.s.)) the man would be desperate to sell himself cheaply to the extent that the man from among them would be prepare to ransom himself with all of his wealth, and seek the salvation for himself. So he will not achieve anything from that. And they have taken us (a.s.) and our (a.s.) Shites out from those rights of ours without an excuse, or right, or proof’.

I said, ‘The Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: “[9:52] Say: Do you await for us but one of two most excellent things?” He (a.s.) said: ‘But it is death in obedience to Allah (azwj) or realisation of the appearance of Imam (a.s.) (Al-Qaim (a.s.), And we await for you that Allah will afflict you with punishment from Himself and it is metamorphosis or by our hands and it is the killing. Allah (azwj) Said to His (azwj) Prophet (saww): “So wait; we too will wait with you”. And the waiting is for the occurrence of the affliction upon their (a.s.) enemies’.
